name: robinhood
notes: Robinhood Chain mainnet (Arbitrum Orbit, gas in ETH). The public RPC is rate-limited; point ROBINHOOD_RPC at a QuickNode/Dwellir/ArrowRPC endpoint for the keeper and watcher. $RIG is launched on Pons and graduates to a Uniswap v3 RIG/WETH pool (1% tier) whose position is locked by the Pons locker; there is no fungible LP token, so LP staking is off (lpToken zero). Fill rig with the graduated token address, deploy OpenEligibility and ChainlinkOracle (feeds above), set treasury. Testnet: chain id 46630 (RPC/faucet to confirm).
quoteToken: USDG (verify decimals() on chain; the vault reads it at construction)
feedsNote: Chainlink per-token feeds (docs.chain.link/data-feeds/price-feeds/addresses?network=robinhood). Deploy ChainlinkOracle(stocks, feeds) and put its address in `oracle`. Deploy OpenEligibility and put it in `eligibility`: Stock Tokens have no transfer hook; eligibility is a front-end geo-fence.
